query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM room_memberships m1
                JOIN room_memberships m2 ON m1.room_id = m2.room_id
                WHERE m1.user_id = $1
                  AND m1.membership = 'join'
                  AND m2.membership = 'join'
                  AND m2.user_id LIKE $2
            ) AS "exists!"
